messages:
Anna (eng-security): Hey team, heads up — nightly backup verification reports started failing at 02:10 UTC. Error shows KMS Decrypt denied for restore role.
Jamal (dba): Reproduced locally, `aws rds restore-db-instance-from-s3` fails with KMSAccessDenied.
Anna (eng-security): We did a permissions prune on the backup service last week. @Mohan did that include key policy or grants?
Mohan (ops): I removed a stale IAM role from the backup agent per ticket #4567. I didn't touch KMS grants, just role attached to instance profile.
Luis (crypt): Looking at CloudTrail, I don't see `CreateGrant` events for the last 7 days for that key. But there are Decrypt failures:
`User: arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/backup-restore-role/session ... KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied`
Anna (eng-security): Hmm. Could be the role was removed from key policy by a separate CMK cleanup script. @Mohan can you check key policy history?
Mohan (ops): Running `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/db-backups` now. Policy revision matches pre-prune state. No denies there.
Jamal (dba): We can hotfix by creating a grant for the restore principal: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/db-backups --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/backup-restore-role --operations Decrypt`
Anna (eng-security): Agreed. Also we need to figure out why CloudTrail missed the earlier revoke. @Luis can you cross-check config recorder/s3 bucket access for config delivery? Possibly audit logs dropped.
Luis (crypt): Confirmed — config delivery failed for ~1h on 2026-03-18 due to lifecycle rule transition. S3 object lock lifecycle cycled. That lines up with the time the role lost access.
Anna (eng-security): Action items: 1) Mohan create grant now, 2) Jamal run restore smoke to confirm, 3) Luis restore audit logs to long-term bucket and run timeline, 4) I'll update runbook and add canary restore daily. @oncall-ops stay tuned.
oncall-ops: On it, will monitor and post updates here. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Incident tagged: encops-2026-03-18-grant-loss. Assigned severity: P2. Checklist added to incident tracker.
Jamal (dba): Restore succeeded after grant creation, verified data integrity. Will schedule postmortem tomorrow.
Anna (eng-security): Good work. Also propose adding automated grant re-creation as part of backup deploy to avoid single-point grants.
Mohan (ops): Will add ticket to infra backlog. Thanks all.
